title: Automated dbt Lineage and Metric Governance
business: Data engineering teams managing complex dbt projects with frequent schema changes.
problem: Manual documentation of dbt model dependencies and metric definitions is error-prone, leading to broken downstream dashboards and inconsistent business reporting.
solution: Using the dbt MCP Server within ChatGPT, teams can programmatically inspect project lineage and query semantic layer metrics to ensure documentation matches the actual codebase without leaving the chat interface.
steps: Connect the dbt MCP Server to the project repository to index model metadata.
Use the ChatGPT plugin interface to query the dbt Semantic Layer for current metric definitions.
Generate boilerplate documentation for new models based on existing lineage patterns.
Review model lineage graphs directly in the chat to identify potential breaking changes before deployment.
outcome: Improved consistency in data documentation and reduced time spent manually tracing dependencies during schema migrations.
limitation: The plugin relies on the current state of the dbt project; it cannot predict future schema changes that have not yet been committed to the repository, requiring users to verify the latest branch state manually.
